title: ardisia amherstiana var. pubescens

It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Ardisia amherstiana var. pubescens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiproliferative, and immunomodulatory effects. Additionally, it is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties.
